purpose: gnssmap4 (kernel q10jr5 / 0355, ioctl 124): ONE mapping action per boot after the Wi-Fi read-only guard and a 2 s console pause: control: ml_io_map(0x10006000, 0x6000), the one5 request size through io_submap with a non-GPS PA, no access (EXPECTED TO RESET if io_submap is exhausted). Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
